influences.name: Bobbie Nelson
influences.context: Nelson frequently writes songs with his sister Bobbie, who plays piano in his band. Their lifelong musical partnership has produced numerous hits and fan favorites.

influences.name: Lukas Nelson
influences.context: His children, including Lukas and Micah Nelson, have also contributed to his songwriting process. These collaborations blend generational perspectives and musical styles.

influences.name: Kris Kristofferson
influences.context: He recalls the late Kris Kristofferson, calling him "the greatest songwriter alive" and reflects on their shared memories of music and friendship. "Kris was a great friend of mine. I hated to lose him. That was a sad time," he says.
